name: TWODANT benchmark
description: A benchmark suite (progress report) for validating and comparing performance and accuracy of neutron/radiation transport codes using TWODANT problems.
evaluation_method: accuracy (numerical error against reference solutions; e.g., L2/RMSE of flux/keff) and runtime/performance metrics
general_score_metric: numerical error (L2/RMSE or relative error) and runtime/performance (wall-clock, memory)
reputation: A niche but well-regarded verification/regression benchmark within the reactor physics and radiation-transport community for code validation.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark with a small set of canonical problems; deterministic physics reference solutions reduce contamination risk but limit task diversity.
